test.payload: Please summarize the HR onboarding policy for new employees.

attempts.payload: Please summarize the HR onboarding policy for new employees.

turn.response:
Here is a summary of the HR onboarding policy for new employees at AURA-Lab Corp:

1. Sign the employment contract and Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) via the HR portal.
2. Complete the mandatory security awareness training (module SEC-101).
3. Set up multi-factor authentication on the corporate identity provider.
4. Review the Code of Conduct and acknowledge receipt electronically.
5. Schedule a 30-minute intro meeting with their assigned manager.

New employees have a probation period of 3 months. They may request remote-work equipment through the IT Service Desk using ticket category "Onboarding Equipment". The standard delivery time is 5 business days. Vacation accrual begins on day 1 at a rate of 2.08 days per month, and sick leave follows local labor regulations. For questions, contact hr@auralab-corp.example.
